style: Design Studio for FastLED lighting-console identity: dark precision panels, large approachable technical typography, real application node cards, and one cyan-to-purple-to-magenta signal pulse

customize.reuse: Borrow the block's large editorial hierarchy and deterministic GSAP entrance timing.
handAuthoredGaps: variable-driven title, end, and series-complete modes

layout.title: left column, 108px Audiowide, maximum two lines, 1040px wide
layout.nodeGraph: right third, three real SVG node cards from the application connected left-to-right

scenes.text: Variable-driven tutorial title or next-card copy
scenes.motion: signal path draws from left to right, a pulse travels into the output node, LED pixels illuminate, then metadata and title resolve into a stable hold

motion.dominantMotif: One signal pulse travels left-to-right through the node path and illuminates the destination matrix.

timeline.action: faint grid, structural rules, and node panels fade into the dark workspace
after the real node cards settle, the signal bases fade in on their exact port anchors
the two aligned signal wires draw left-to-right between the visible ports
a bright pulse travels across the completed connections
magenta output node and LED matrix illuminate
series metadata resolves from the left
hero title resolves with a short upward movement and opacity fade
supporting line and progress rail resolve
one restrained LED shimmer keeps the resolved frame gently alive without moving the typography
a second restrained LED shimmer leads into the clean final hold
a third restrained LED shimmer maintains a quiet living hold
a fourth restrained LED shimmer maintains the extended reading hold
a final restrained LED shimmer leads into the fadeout
the complete card fades evenly to the dark background over the final half-second

motion.hold: All copy and primary geometry remain completely stable from 1.72s through 6.5s, followed by a 0.5s full-frame fadeout.

modes.title: BEGINNER SERIES / TUTORIAL NN, hero title, supporting line, current progress square magenta
modes.end: NEXT UP, next tutorial number and title, completed progress squares cyan and next square magenta
modes.complete: SERIES COMPLETE, YOU'RE READY TO BUILD, Create, preview, and perform with Design Studio for FastLED.

content.brief: A reusable title-and-end-card system. The hero frame is left-anchored typography balanced by three authentic application node cards on the right. The official pixel lockup sits in the upper-left. A single signal pulse travels behind the real cards and lights a compact LED matrix. Opening cards resolve to a tutorial title. End cards resolve to NEXT UP, the following tutorial title, and an eleven-pixel progress rail. The final card resolves to SERIES COMPLETE.
